tests.name: assert_campaign_conversions_reconcile
tests.description: Under every model, campaign-level conversions add up to the conversions that were attributed.

tests.name: assert_channel_credits_sum_to_one
tests.description: Each model's channel shares form a full split of the conversions.

tests.name: assert_clicks_follow_impressions
tests.description: A click cannot happen before the impression it came from, or belong to another user.

tests.name: assert_credit_inside_window
tests.description: No impression gets credit for a conversion that came before it, or after the window closed.

tests.name: assert_spend_reconciles
tests.description: Daily and campaign marts must add up to the same spend as the impressions they came from.

tests.name: assert_touchpoint_credits_sum_to_one
tests.description: Every heuristic model hands out exactly one conversion's worth of credit per conversion.
